analysis.directory.label: Entries
analysis.directory.instructions: Every entry on this page, one row each, in reading order, column by column.

fields.label: Name
fields.instructions: The name as printed, surname and forenames in the order given.

fields.label: Occupation
fields.instructions: The occupation, trade or title as printed; empty when none.

fields.label: Address
fields.instructions: The street and number, or the place, as printed; empty when none.

fields.label: Remarks
fields.instructions: Anything else the entry gives (a telephone number, a date, an abbreviation), as printed; empty when nothing.

analysis.entities.label: Organisations
analysis.entities.instructions: Associations, parties, administrations, companies, religious bodies.

analysis.image_description.label: Description
analysis.image_description.instructions: What is visibly there, following the instructions above, in {languages}; the first sentence a summary on its own.

analysis.image_description.label: Kind of image
analysis.image_description.instructions: What the image is as an object, not what it shows.

analysis.image_description.label: Keywords
analysis.image_description.instructions: Subjects visibly present, in {languages}, specific before general, with no two saying the same thing.

analysis.image_description.label: Text in the image
analysis.image_description.instructions: Captions, signs, inscriptions and stamps, as written, one per line; empty when there is none.

analysis.image_description.label: People
analysis.image_description.instructions: People named in the image's own text.

analysis.image_description.label: Places
analysis.image_description.instructions: Places named in the image's own text.

analysis.image_description.label: Organisations
analysis.image_description.instructions: Organisations named in the image's own text.

analysis.interview.label: Summary
analysis.interview.instructions: Who speaks and what the interview covers, following the instructions above.

analysis.interview.label: Themes
analysis.interview.instructions: The subjects the interviewee comes back to or develops, the most important first, each backed by one to three quotations.

fields.label: Name
fields.instructions: The theme in a few words, in {languages}.

fields.label: Description
fields.instructions: What the interviewee says about it, in one or two sentences, in {languages}.

analysis.interview.label: Keywords
analysis.interview.instructions: Keywords and short key phrases in {languages} that someone would search for: people, organisations, places, events and specific themes. Prefer the specific ("Hajj 1957") to the general ("religion"), and keep proper names as in the source.

analysis.interview.label: Quotations
analysis.interview.instructions: The passages most worth quoting, the most telling first, preferring the interviewee's words.

analysis.register.label: Entries
analysis.register.instructions: Every entry on this page, one row each, in the order written.

fields.label: Number
fields.instructions: The entry's number as written; empty when none.

fields.label: Name
fields.instructions: The person the entry is about, as written.

fields.label: Place
fields.instructions: The place the entry names for them, as written; empty when none.

fields.label: People named
fields.instructions: The other people the entry names (parents, spouse, witnesses, the clerk), each as written.

fields.label: Remarks
fields.instructions: Marginal notes and anything else the entry records, as written; empty when nothing.

analysis.screening.label: Relevance
analysis.screening.instructions: Whether the document speaks of the researcher's question, following the instructions above.

analysis.screening.label: Reason
analysis.screening.instructions: Why, in one or two sentences, in {languages}.

analysis.screening.label: Passages
analysis.screening.instructions: The passages that speak of the question, the most telling first; none when the document does not speak of it.

analysis.summary_publication.label: Reference
analysis.summary_publication.instructions: Authors, year, title, and the journal, book or institution it appeared in, as the publication gives them. Leave out what it does not state.

analysis.summary_publication.label: Type
analysis.summary_publication.instructions: What kind of publication this is.

analysis.summary_publication.label: Abstract
analysis.summary_publication.instructions: An abstract of 150 to 250 words in your own words: the question, the case, the approach, the argument and the main findings.

analysis.summary_publication.label: Research question
analysis.summary_publication.instructions: The question or puzzle the publication sets out to answer, in one or two sentences.

analysis.summary_publication.label: Argument
analysis.summary_publication.instructions: The central argument or thesis, and the debate or received view it speaks to or argues against.

analysis.summary_publication.label: Theoretical framework
analysis.summary_publication.instructions: The theories and concepts the analysis rests on, and the scholars it explicitly builds on or discusses.

analysis.summary_publication.label: Methods
analysis.summary_publication.instructions: The methods the publication itself uses, not those it only discusses.

analysis.summary_publication.label: Data and sources
analysis.summary_publication.instructions: What the study rests on: fieldwork (where, when, how long), interviews (how many, with whom), archives, press, surveys or corpora, as the publication describes them.

analysis.summary_publication.label: Places studied
analysis.summary_publication.instructions: Countries, regions, towns or sites the study is about, not every place mentioned.

analysis.summary_publication.label: Period studied
analysis.summary_publication.instructions: The period the study covers, as precisely as the publication states it ("1960 to 1990", "the 2010s").

analysis.summary_publication.label: Main findings
analysis.summary_publication.instructions: The main findings or claims, each in one sentence, the most important first, as plain prose.

analysis.summary_publication.label: Contribution and limits
analysis.summary_publication.instructions: What the authors say the publication adds to the field, and the limits they acknowledge themselves.

analysis.summary_publication.label: Key concepts
analysis.summary_publication.instructions: The analytical concepts the publication uses or proposes, in its own terms.

analysis.summary_publication.label: Keywords
analysis.summary_publication.instructions: Keywords in {languages} that someone would search for: the topic, groups, institutions, places and themes. Prefer the specific ("Islamic reformism in Niger") to the general ("religion").

analysis.summary_research.label: Summary
analysis.summary_research.instructions: What this document in particular says, following the instructions above.

analysis.summary_research.label: Keywords
analysis.summary_research.instructions: Keywords and short key phrases in {languages} that someone would search for: people, organisations, places, events and specific themes. Prefer the specific ("Hajj 1957") to the general ("religion"), and keep proper names as in the source.

analysis.tone.label: Main subject
analysis.tone.instructions: What the document is mainly about, in a few words, in {languages}.

analysis.tone.label: Tone
analysis.tone.instructions: How the document presents its main subject.

analysis.tone.label: Register
analysis.tone.instructions: How much the document reports facts and how much it gives opinions.

contents.archival_file.label: Kind of document
contents.archival_file.instructions: What the item is, in a few words: letter, report, minutes, telegram, circular, petition, form, newspaper clipping, photograph, map, envelope…

contents.archival_file.label: Date
contents.archival_file.instructions: The item's date as written, then in the form YYYY-MM-DD in parentheses when it is complete; empty when the item has none.

contents.archival_file.label: From
contents.archival_file.instructions: Who wrote, signed or issued it, with their title or office, as written.

contents.archival_file.label: To
contents.archival_file.instructions: Who it is addressed or copied to, with their title or office, as written.

contents.archival_file.label: Summary
contents.archival_file.instructions: What the item says or records, in two to four sentences, with its names, places, figures and dates, and the annotations or stamps on it.

contents.archival_file.label: Names
contents.archival_file.instructions: People, organisations and places the item names, as written.

contents.book.label: Level
contents.book.instructions: Whether the entry is a part, a chapter (or a contribution to an edited volume), or a section within a chapter.

contents.book.label: Authors
contents.book.instructions: Its authors, when the entry names its own (in an edited volume); empty otherwise.

contents.book.label: Summary
contents.book.instructions: What it argues or describes, with its names, cases, figures and dates: one or two sentences for one page, three to five for a whole chapter or section.

contents.periodical.label: Authors
contents.periodical.instructions: The authors as the article names them ("By …", a signature at the end), including collective ones ("The Editors"); empty when none is named.

contents.periodical.label: Summary
contents.periodical.instructions: What the article says, with its names, figures and dates: two or three sentences for one page, four to six for the whole article.
